Class database

java.lang.Object
database
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class database extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Opens the PostgreSQL connection, manages records, and retrieves sales reports.

    • insertOrder

      public int insertOrder(int employeeId, List<database.SaleItem> sales) throws SQLException
      Saves one checkout as a single order in one transaction. Each drink becomes its own sales_history row sharing the same order id, and each topping is saved as a sale_topping row. If any insert fails, the whole order is rolled back.
      Parameters:
      employeeId - cashier employee id
      sales - drinks in the order
      Returns:
      generated order id
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the database operation fails or a selected record no longer exists
      IllegalArgumentException - if the order is empty or contains invalid values
